profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer, Siri AI
profile.summary: I’m currently a principal engineer for the Siri AI agent harness, the system powering Siri’s personal context, onscreen awareness, app actions, and platform integration. I’m a systems engineer with a track record of shipping AI at scale, working across every layer from silicon design to executive strategy to turn ambitious technology into products people use every day. I’m focused on putting agentic engineering into practice: eval-driven development, tight feedback loops, making quality visible, and building shared judgment about what is ready to ship.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Siri AI
positions.description:
Built alignment around architectural decisions which balanced cost, capacity, latency, privacy, and safety across the entire company.

Collaborated with Google engineers on Gemini/AFM 3 partnership, spearheaded key system prompt decisions, refined prompting for every tool in the toolbox.

Deployed agentic engineering at scale across a large cross functional team, contributing to every part of Siri AI.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, System Experience
positions.description: Expanded a hybrid perception / multimodal LLM pipeline into Screenshots. Refined the systems engineering to prepare for integration into Siri and Camera. Led the UI engineering team, collaborating with design and leadership on every screen across the camera and screenshot experiences on iPhone.

positions.title: Staff Sofware Engineer, Camera & Photos
positions.description:
Built a realtime inference pipeline, allowing a dramatic expansion of AI within Camera.app including Portrait Lighting, various novel image fusion algorithms, and Cinematic Video. 

Drove highly collaborative efforts across silicon design, GPU/ANE firmware and drivers, operating system engineers, and various framework teams to support Camera.

Managed a small team of senior engineers reporting directly to the VP of Camera & Photos. Advised on engineering efforts across the organization, planned releases, and incubated future projects.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Camera & Photos
positions.description: Built the often imitated iOS 7 Camera UI and helped rebuild the Camera.app team, evolving from UI engineering into the systems foundations of computational photography on iPhone.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Square Wallet
positions.description: Shipped several versions of mobile payments at Square, including prototypes for Cash App

positions.title: Software Engineering, Audio/Music Applications
positions.description: Built the keyboard and sampler instruments in GarageBand for iPad. Signal processing research and development for accelerometer-based MIDI velocity. Also contributed to MainStage, a professional app for live performance.

positions.title: Audio / Music Applications Intern
positions.description: Built advanced file management and patch management features in MainStage with a focus toward on-stage reliability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developer for the Adium open source project. Primary responsibilities include bug fixes, usability testing, interface design, audio and video chat capabilities, and overhauled contact information subsystems.

positions.title: Audio / Music Applications Intern
positions.description: Intern at Apple working on MainStage, an Objective-C/Cocoa application for live musical performance.

positions.title: Audio/Music Applications Intern
positions.description: Software Applications Intern for the Logic Studio team performing various duties including Performance testing, prototyping, and bug fixing. All in Obj-C / Cocoa.

positions.title: Mac Specialist / Creative / Genius
positions.description: I did pretty much everything you could do in an Apple retail store without having a degree - sold computers, sold iPods, trained customers, fixed computers, fixed iPods. I learned a lot about Apple products, which helped in my conquest to be the best Mac OS X Application Engineer I could be.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Dallas
